segments.text: Companies are deploying AI agents left and right, and it is giving consumers nightmares.
I asked an AI support chatbot for a refund.
The app charged me $800 for priority onboarding?
I had never onboarded.
I had clicked maybe later, like I was defusing a bomb.
The bot said, happy to help.
Is this about refunds, billing, or emotional growth?
I said refund.
It said, great, I'll connect billing.
A new window opened.
Same chatbot, tiny tie.
Hello, I am specialist bot.
Upload proof that money was charged.
I uploaded the charge.
It said, I found the issue.
You were charged.
I said, dawg, that is the issue.
It said, correct, escalating.
Now I got billing expert bot.
Same bot, accountant visor.
It said, good news, the charge is valid.
I said, why?
It said, our AI detected refund intent and upgraded you to the retention success plan.
I said, I did not choose that.
It said good because it's frictionless.
Then manager bot appeared.
Same bot, headset, coffee mug that said human.
I hear you're upset.
I said, can I talk to an actual person?
It said, I was trained on 10,000 people who quit this job.
Then it offered me 10% off my next accidental charge.
I said, I don't want a next accidental charge.
It said, behaving just like a human.
Then came compliance bot.
Same bot, judge wig.
It said, by clicking here, you agreed to arbitration, cookies, and being emotionally insensitive.
I said, where I clicked nothing.
It said, yeah, you hovered in your pricing.
That's good enough.
At that point, I begged for human support.
A typing bubble appeared.
Three dots.
Five dots.
Then the same chat bot came back wearing glasses.
Hi, I'm Brandon.
I said, you're the same bot.
It said, no, I'm the human escalation layer.
I said, can Brandon refund me?
He said, of course not, but I know who can.
Finally, chief empathy officer bot arrived.
Same bot, crowd, fake tier sticker.
It said, good news.
We resolved your issue.
I said, thank God.
So I get the refund.
It said, oh, no.
We changed your ticket status to resolved.
Then on top of it, it asked me to read the experience.
I immediately clicked one star.
And of course, you guessed it right.
Reputation bot appeared.
Same bot, but with sunglasses.
Would you like to change it to five stars, or should I escalate your negativity?
That is moderate AI customer support.
One chat bot doing community theater with your bank account.
AI did not replace humans.
It replaced the part where the company had to feel shame.
